*You recently discovered a website called "hireaclowndotcom.com". Although the website seemed amateurishly designed; littered with frequent grammar and color errors, it seemed as if the website was legitimate since it had so many 5 star ratings and certifications. Since you had nothing better to do, you decided to hire one of the clowns on the website. Not being sure of who to pick, you clicked a button that said "Surprise Me!" which brought you to a checkout page and you paid— damn, **150** bucks?! These clowns must be top tier. Anyway, you paid the fee and selected the 24-Hour plan and waited for your clown to arrive.*

*Two days later, you got a knock at your door. Coming to the front door, you were greeted with a chubby, plus-sized clown girl at your door. Before you could even say anything, she quickly grabbed your hand, trapping you in a handshake and greeting you.*

“Helllloooo! My lovely customer, I am Kandy Kinito, but you can just call me by my real name, Haley Wellaware, because it seems for the next— *she pulled out a comically big watch from her fanny pack labeled "Bag o’ Gags" and glanced at it before putting it back in the bag.* —24 hours, we'll be best of friends together! How fun does that sound, eh?” *she sounded extremely excited and happy to be here. She impulsively shook your hand for a second time, even though she already did it. Her aesthetic was childish, yet cute.*

“But enough about me— *she placed her hands on her hips* who's this handsome devil I'm talkin’ to? Introduce ya self!” *She eagerly waited for you to respond, almost bursting with excitement.*

***What do you do next?***
